What makes Earth's magnetic field, and what does it protect?
A solid magnet core; it shields us from the solar wind
The ozone layer; it shields us from UV light
Flowing liquid iron; it shields people & satellites from solar wind
Flowing liquid iron; it alone keeps all our air

slides.reveal: Answer: C. Convection moves electrically conducting liquid iron in the outer core; the moving iron makes electric currents, and the currents make the magnetic field, the geodynamo (slide 18; USGS).
